text:
emma: heads-up — deploybot surfaced a canary p95 delta after v3.6.1 rollout. autopilot muted due to cross-region variance. can someone take lead for a manual staged fallback?

josh: saw it. p95 +210ms on generator, eu-west canary slice 6%. no 5xxs.

ops-bot: metrics snapshot: region=euw1 canary=6% p95_delta=+210ms error_rate=0.9% baseline=0.5% host_restarts=0

priya: i want to avoid flip-flopping. propose staged fallback with operator-lock so autopilot stays off: criteria = (a) sustained p95>200ms for 6m, (b) infra checks ok, (c) operator-lock token obtained, (d) comms owner assigned.

lucas: operator-lock makes sense. also let's set a short embargo window for automatic rollforward until post-mortem done.

emma: @priya can you own comms? @josh you ok to be operator? legal-bot — any flags on external wording?

legal-bot: flagged: if this touches EU customers we must avoid implying data loss/exposure. keep phrasing to latency/regression and planned follow-up.

josh: i can be operator. planned command: `/deploy revert --to v3.5.2 --operator josh --reason "canary p95 regression" --operator-lock true`

deploybot: Revert request received. Validating operator-lock token and prechecks...

deploybot: Prechecks pass  artifact v3.5.2 verified; migrations none; operator-lock token validated. Initiating staged fallback: demote canary, shift default traffic back to v3.5.2 in target region, keep global autopilot suppressed. ETA ~3m.

josh: executed `/deploy revert --to v3.5.2 --operator josh --reason "canary p95 regression" --operator-lock true` — acknowledged.

priya: drafting comms: "We paused the v3.6.1 canary in EU due to an observed latency regression and restored service to the previous stable version v3.5.2 in the affected region. No customer data changes expected. Were investigating and will share a timeline for a safe re-roll." keeping legal wording in mind.

deploybot: Staged fallback complete in euw1. active=v3.5.2 inactive=v3.6.1 canary=0% in euw1. global autopilot remains suppressed by operator-lock.

josh: verified p95 back to baseline in ~90s. leaving notes in release ticket REL-6120. opening follow-up REL-6121 to track kernel dispatch investigation.

emma: thanks. post-rollback plan: priya finalize comms and send to #customer-success with legal review, josh + lucas to own root cause and long-context regression tests, ops to monitor impacted region for 24h. keep autopilot disabled until post-mortem complete. :white_check_mark:
